chunks: Whatever is in it from Zurārah ibn Aʿyun, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAbdullāh ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā ibn ʿUbayd, al-Ḥasan ibn Ẓarīf, and ʿAlī ibn Ismāʿīl ibn ʿĪsā, all of them from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Zurārah ibn Aʿyun.

key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: A nisbah identifying ʿAbdullāh ibn Jaʿfar as al-Ḥimyarī.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; the author’s statement of direct transmission through his chain.
key_terms.عَنْ: From; the standard connective term in a sanad/isnad indicating transmission.
key_terms.كُلِّهِمْ: All of them; indicating that the named narrators jointly transmit from the next narrator.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for the narrations of Zurara ibn A'yun in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage records the transmission chain for reports attributed to Zurara ibn A'yun in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the sanad/isnad through which the author received these narrations, linking them through recognized transmitters back to Zurara.
